objective: Ship six destination-grade live decision tools with comparison, best-window analysis, score anatomy, map/access context and explicit source typing, while keeping /tools/ protected until September 22.

truthLoss.description: Penalizes overclaiming live state, missing source boundaries, unsafe certainty, and missing fail-soft behavior.
hardFailures: claims actual trail depth/mud/closure without source

decisionLoss.description: Penalizes pages that do not convert data into a destination-specific verdict, live signal, context, timing, selector and next action.

depthLoss.description: Penalizes thin tools that lack live comparison, best-window analysis, score anatomy, source typing, map/access context or the V2 depth engine.

homogeneityLoss.description: Penalizes six near-identical shells by requiring a distinct V2 decision feature and distinct scoring intent for every tool.

measurement.primary: Search Console qualified impressions and clicks
measurement.secondary: privacy-safe selector changes and outbound decision handoffs

tools.launchGate: truthLoss <= 10; decisionLoss <= 20; depthLoss <= 10; homogeneityLoss <= 10; bestFitScore >= 70; full repo verify green
